bits_per_sample.docs:
**positive integer**: The number of bits per sample to send to the output speaker. Either `8`, `16`, `24`, or `32`. Defaults to the output speaker's bits per sample.

*See also: [Mixer Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer#configuration-variables)*

num_channels.docs:
**positive integer**: The number of audio channels to send to the output speaker. Either `1` or `2`. Defaults to the output speaker's number of channels.

*See also: [Mixer Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer#configuration-variables)*

output_speaker.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The [speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) to output the mixed audio.

*See also: [Mixer Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer#configuration-variables)*

queue_mode.docs:
**boolean**: Enables queue mode. If enabled, audio isn't mixed but instead each source speaker's audio is played successively, starting with the first listed source speaker.

*See also: [Mixer Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer#configuration-variables)*

buffer_duration.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The duration of the internal ring buffer. Larger values can reduce stuttering but use more memory. Defaults to `100ms`.

*See also: [Mixer Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer#configuration-variables)*

timeout.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: How long to wait after finishing playback before releasing the bus. Set to `never` to never stop the speaker due to a timeout. Defaults to `500ms`.

*See also: [Mixer Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer#configuration-variables)*

source_speakers.docs:
**list**: A list of source speaker inputs. Must have at least 2 and at most 8 speakers.

*See also: [Mixer Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer#configuration-variables)*

task_stack_in_psram.docs:
**boolean**: Only with `esp-idf`. Run the audio tasks in external memory. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Mixer Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/mixer#configuration-variables)*
